name: 智绘教 Inkeys
tagline: 丝滑流畅的屏幕批注工具
description: 智绘教 Inkeys 是一款适用于 Windows 的屏幕批注工具，拥有丝滑流畅的高性能画笔、丰富强大的功能和不少贴心小设计，适用于触控屏和普通 PC。上课时直接在屏幕或课件上圈画讲解很方便，是希沃课堂助手、Luminalium 之外的又一优秀批注工具。
descriptionEn: Inkeys is a Windows screen annotation tool with a high-performance, smooth pen, rich features and thoughtful details for touchscreens and ordinary PCs. It is handy for circling and explaining content during lessons, and is another strong annotation option alongside Seewo Classroom Assistant and Luminalium.
author: Alan-CRL
